study: Dolfin et al. 2019 — Teacher Potential Project (EL Education ELA curriculum + embedded PD) RCT (Mathematica)
delivery_evidence: Three PD components are a genuine in-person + online mix: (1) on-site institutes; (2) on-site AND video-based coaching; (3) online supports including online PD materials, online communities of practice, and interactive webinars. (PD model description; fidelity chapter, pp. ~30-32)
test_alignment_evidence: Outcomes are state ELA assessments standardized to a national norming population — broad independent standardized tests not tailored to TPP content. (Table VI.1, p. 64)
curriculum_evidence: TPP provides an open-source, CCSS-aligned EL Education ELA curriculum (grades 3-8) paired with the embedded PD; treatment schools adopt and implement this new curriculum. ('TPP provides an ELA curriculum paired with teacher professional learning supports'; ELA curriculum implementation chapter)
outcome_timing_evidence: Primary impacts measured at end of schools' second study year (immediate); the table also reports a one-year follow-up contrast (S9) measured the year AFTER a single year of TPP, with TPP discontinued (delayed). (Table VI.1, p. 64; rows S4/S6 vs S9)
